review.assessment: The change replaces the broken `head | tail` arithmetic pipeline with `sed -n "${start},${end}p"`, which natively supports 1-indexed, inclusive line ranges. It also adds a guard for inverted ranges (`start > end`) to prevent undefined or incorrect behavior from the range syntax. The script now correctly handles all specified edge cases (single-line requests, END past EOF, START past EOF) without off-by-one errors.
